evaluation.numerical_advantage: all32 empirical choice loss strictly lower than fixed03 AND fixed30 AND training-only cost-intercept; descriptive flag, not significance/safety/acceleration
evaluation.primary: equal-state all32 empirical choice loss max(mean03,mean30)-mean(chosen first action); source-macro also reported; not true regret or online policy return
evaluation.prior_exposure: all32 states, outcomes and multiple model results already used in development; no new independent route claims
secondary: original6 confirmed correctness and10 unknown retained
new5 descriptive correctness and11 unknown retained
pairwise TRAINING-normalized held cost-logistic loss vs training-only intercept
prior scaled-ridge frozen result read only
evaluation.unknowns: included in all32 empirical cost, never forced into accuracy denominator

exit_rule: freeze this bounded preference experiment regardless of outcome; no automatic data expansion, lambda sweep, network scan, relabeling unknown states or MCTS integration

model.initialization: all weights zero, intercept training-only log(sumA/sumB)
model.lambda_rationale: one fixed unit penalty after training-only cost normalization; no grid or outer-outcome tuning. Not numerically equivalent to lambda1 in squared-loss ridge.
model.not_an_ablation_claim: new objective plus logistic link and solver; no attribution to one changed ingredient
model.one_sided_or_zero_train_cost: analytic constant boundary solution; serialized explicitly, no invented finite logit, no fit retry
model.predictor: f=Z@w+b; score=sigmoid(f); choose03 if f>=0 else30; exact ties03
model.seed_reason: deterministic convex model, no randomized initialization
model.solver: damped Newton; solve37x37 Newton system with backtracking on TRAINING objective only
model.standardization: same preceding training-only population mean/std; training std<=1e-12 columns zeroed on both train and held; no held clipping

new_question: Can a bounded cost-weighted two-action preference model reduce empirical first-action choice loss on held source groups, without regressing the numerical return gap?

search_bridge.future_proposal_if_useful: separately authorize a no-pruning sidecar or relative03/30 expansion-order comparison preserving all legal actions and budget; actual integration must be checked against live source

supervision.C: training-only mean(A+B); if zero, exact no-signal constant score0.5, no pseudolabel
supervision.loss: sum over n training states of [A*softplus(-f)+B*softplus(f)]/(n*C) + 0.5*lambda*||w||^2
supervision.original_target_unchanged: Y64; the first forced action reward is included; subsequent native B64/H8 policy; CAP Y64 observed, full-task tail unknown
supervision.pairing: all8x8 cross-action arithmetic comparisons per state; not new or independent samples; keep each whole state and source run in its own fold
supervision.unknown_semantics: A/(A+B) is an empirical cost-balance target, NOT reliable hard preference, safety probability, calibrated win probability, or Q*; original training masks and labels remain unchanged
supervision.why_not_plain_win_fraction: unequal return losses matter; simple majority of sampled pair wins does not necessarily maximize sample mean return
supervision.zero_differences: contribute zero cost, never treated as a negative action; states remain in reporting denominator
